name: GrapLeomon
main_effect:
＜Fortitude＞ (When this Digimon with digivolution cards is deleted, play this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Return 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 4000 DP or less to the bottom of the deck.
source_effect: [Your Turn] While this Digimon has [Leomon] in its name, it gains ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)
